semiconductor_relevance: High — Nova Fabrica provides critical subsystems and components for vacuum coating and plasma processing, which are essential in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Nova Fabrica is a Lithuania-based engineering company specializing in optimizing yield and energy efficiency in vacuum coating, thin film, and plasma processing. They offer a comprehensive range of services, including the development of critical subsystems, metrology services, and on-site support, tailored for OEMs and end-users in the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Development and manufacturing of critical subsystems and components

regional_presence.Lithuania: The company is based in Lithuania, focusing on engineering solutions for the semiconductor sector.
